name: pep-sample-client
description: PEP repository sample web client consumer
// devDependencies.webpack: Held at 5.108.x. webpack.config.mjs sets `importMeta: false` so that webpack leaves pepWeblib.mjs's own uses of `import.meta.url` alone (otherwise it replaces them with the build machine's file path). From 5.109 on (https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/21327), that setting also stops webpack from copying pepWeblib.wasm into dist/: the build still succeeds, but the sample client cannot load. Before upgrading, build and check that dist/ contains a .wasm file.
